title: Circuit polynomial time as a union of advice classes
statement: The class of Boolean languages decidable by polynomial-size fan-in-two circuit families equals the union, over natural numbers $c,d$, of the classes decidable by a polynomial-time Turing machine with advice strings of length exactly $n^d$ on inputs of length $n$.
